mapper.sql: SELECT f.feedback_id, f.feedback_no, f.feedback_type, f.title, f.content, f.input_id, f.input_name, f.supplier_id, f.supplier_name,f.input_category, f.input_type, f.contact_name, f.contact_phone, f.contact_email, f.status, f.handler_id, f.handle_time, f.handle_result, f.handle_remark, f.satisfaction, f.evaluation, f.evaluation_time, f.create_time, f.create_by, f.update_time, f.update_by, handler.nick_name as handler_name, CASE WHEN f.handle_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, f.create_time, f.handle_time) ELSE NULL END as processing_hours FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN sys_user handler ON f.handler_id = handler.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('FB', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(COALESCE(COUNT(*) + 1, 1), 4, '0')) FROM feedback WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d')

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalFeedbacks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as closedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as todayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(create_time) = YEARWEEK(NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as weekCount, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as monthCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN handle_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, handle_time) ELSE NULL END), 2) as avgProcessingHours, ROUND(AVG(satisfaction), 2) as avgSatisfaction, SUM(CASE WHEN feedback_type = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as complaintCount, SUM(CASE WHEN feedback_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as suggestionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN feedback_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as consultationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN feedback_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as bugReportCount FROM feedback WHERE del_flag = '0'
